why_ai: Already automated advice; fiduciary registration and custody keep a regulated firm in place.
why_clarity: Rebalancing and harvesting are codified algorithms, but client outcomes show over years.
why_digital: Advice, trading and service delivered through an app and website.

why_ai: Inferring client behaviour from app activity is a machine-learning problem on observed data.
why_clarity: Whether understanding keeps clients invested is only proven at the next drawdown.
why_digital: Behavioural app data analysed entirely in software.

why_ai: Interventions are automated messages and experiments, with occasional licensed calls.
why_clarity: Effects of interventions are unknown and testable only during rare drawdowns.
why_digital: Messages and experiments delivered through the app.

why_ai: Classifying aggregated outside positions is automatable, though whole-picture planning adds judgment.
why_clarity: Aggregated holdings are concrete, but planning quality shows only over years.
why_digital: Aggregated account data advised on entirely online.

why_ai: Per-client attribution over complete records is calculation software performs directly.
why_clarity: Net value delivered against a stated alternative is an exact, computable number.
why_digital: Account records in, client statements out, all digital.

why_ai: Predicting drawdown behaviour from observed activity is a labelled prediction problem.
why_clarity: Prediction is well posed, but labels arrive only when markets fall.
why_digital: App behaviour data modelled entirely in software.

why_ai: Registered principals must approve communications, though pre-send testing automates analysis.
why_clarity: Each template is checked against written communication rules before sending.
why_digital: Templates and messages reviewed in compliance software.

why_ai: Harvesting and wash-sale detection are algorithmic and already executed by software.
why_clarity: Realised losses and wash-sale exposure are exact per-client calculations.
why_digital: Trades executed and measured entirely in software.

why_ai: Licensed associates must personally handle frightened clients' calls on the worst market days.
why_clarity: Calls recur in waves, but whether a call kept a client invested shows later.
why_digital: Phone and app service delivered remotely from a central team.

why_ai: A few dollars of fee buys no human attention, so only automation serves them.
why_clarity: Standard allocation machinery is applied identically to many small accounts.
why_digital: Fully app-based service for small accounts.

why_ai: Detecting stalled transfers and stopped contributions is event monitoring software performs directly.
why_clarity: A transfer completes or stalls, and a contribution arrives or stops.
why_digital: Transfer and funding events handled entirely online.
